name: K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN)
when_to_use: Classification or regression by similarity; categorical or metric dependent variable, metric/scaled predictors, no assumption of functional form.
notes: Classifies or predicts a new case by looking at the most similar already-known cases. Applications: simple recommendation, diagnosis by profile similarity.

expected_input.question: What is the expected class or value of a new case, looking at the most similar already-known cases?

plain_explanation.purpose: Classifies or predicts by looking at the most similar already-known neighbors.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When 'those who are alike behave alike' makes sense and the dataset is small.
plain_explanation.data_needed: A table with numeric factors and the known response of each case.
plain_explanation.example: Predict a new customer's plan from the 5 most similar customers.
plain_explanation.diagram: new point -> 5 nearest neighbors -> majority decides
